Description: Faceting demo: declared facets and a named scope over the Bookstore-Tenant fixture (Book <- Review), so the Bookstore explorer shows the cross-entity kinds next to the auto facets: a multi-valued Terms through a child table (K9), a child-count band (K12 ChildRollup), an exists split (K20) and an Exists scope. Validated against the M2 registry (0 disabled, 0 warnings).

Book.WellReviewed.Description: Books with at least one review rated 4 or 5

Facets.Title: Review rating
Facets.Description: Books by the ratings their reviews gave (a book counts once per distinct rating it received, so the buckets can sum to more than the total).
